directives: Pace: 15.32–29.44 cuts a minute across the channel's films (median 23.14); median shot 0.733 s; shot lengths vary a lot (CV 1.784).
By position: cold open 18.36 cuts/min with text on 56% of shots; chapter openings 22.16; middle 22.35; ending 26.81.
Pictures (every shot counted): stock_actor+text 23%, stock_actor 19%, designed+text 18%, stock_broll+text 11%, stock_broll 10%, designed 7%.
Transitions (on the sampled cuts): none 52%, cut 28%, dissolve 11%, other 6%, flash 2%, whip 1%, dip 0%.
Cuts and the voice: 4% of cuts fall in a pause; the median cut sits 0.063 s from a word boundary.
Lines with a number get text on screen 1.35× as often as average; lines naming someone show real footage/photos 7% of the time.
Sound: 0.85 strong hits a minute, 29% of them on a cut; hit classes boom/impact 45%, thud/hit 44%, click/pop 5%.
Music: a cue change within 6 s of 46% of chapter starts; a drop-out just before 23% of them; 10.774 cue changes per 10 min.

Variety: the channel's films differ — e.g. text share varies by 11% across films; two films' looks differ by 0.074 (within one film 0.036). Land each film somewhere different inside the band, not on the average.

Grade: the look moves between chapters — saturation shifts by about 0.148 and brightness by 0.144 (0–1 scale) between a film's chapters; across the film saturation runs 0.291 → 0.297 → 0.29 → 0.297 → 0.311 → 0.346 → 0.293 → 0.298 → 0.311 → 0.293.

Views (a weak, observational tie-breaker inside the band, not a target): the channel's more-watched films have less picture.designed (top quartile 0.162 vs median 0.264); more picture.stock_actor (top quartile 0.545 vs median 0.396); less luma (top quartile 0.321 vs median 0.347); less wordsPerShot (top quartile 9.212 vs median 9.87); more cutsPerMin (top quartile 29.44 vs median 23.14); more faceShare (top quartile 0.628 vs median 0.571).
